shared_elements: flat rectangular framed surface bearing carving
justification: A shows a densely populated stela with a winged disc at top, banded rows of text, and multiple registers of seated and kneeling figures with offerings, whereas B is a large rock-cut wall face with at most one or two eroded standing figures in shallow niches and a largely blank inscribed panel. The only real correspondence is the generic presence of human figures in relief on a flat framed field, which any relief-carving tradition could produce independently; the multi-register narrative scheme of A has no counterpart in B.
